props.name: open
props.purpose: Controls whether the focus-contained foreground layer is mounted.

props.name: title
props.purpose: Visible heading and accessible name for the bounded task.

props.name: description
props.purpose: Optional concise context announced with the title.

props.name: initialFocusRef
props.values: React ref to a contained focus target
props.purpose: Optional caller-selected first focus target inside the layer.

props.name: footer
props.purpose: Optional caller-owned actions, normally governed Button instances.

props.name: children
props.purpose: Caller-owned task content within the scrolling body region.

props.name: onRequestClose
props.purpose: Sole dismissal request boundary; the parent decides whether closing proceeds.

assertions.sourceIncludes: title must be a visible, non-empty string
assertions.docsIncludes: An empty title or missing close callback renders no layer and warns in development.
Escape, veil click, and the close control report distinct reasons

assertions.testIncludes: requires pointer down and up on the veil
assertions.docsIncludes: A drag that starts or ends on the surface never becomes a veil dismissal.
assertions.explanationIncludes: requires pointer down and pointer up on the veil

assertions.testIncludes: contains keyboard focus and restores the opener
assertions.docsIncludes: Tab and Shift+Tab remain inside the open layer; closing restores the opener when it still exists.

assertions.testIncludes: locks page scroll and makes background content inert
assertions.docsIncludes: While open, the page behind the layer is inert and body scrolling is locked.
A second simultaneous Modal is rejected instead of nesting focus traps.

assertions.testIncludes: falls back from an unsupported size
assertions.docsIncludes: Unsupported sizes warn and fall back to regular.
assertions.explanationIncludes: invalid size falls back to regular
